description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the task count across various language families, categorized by which model performed better. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are language families ordered alphabetically: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the "task count" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 40 with horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars for each language family, arranged side-by-side. According to the legend titled "better," the components represent three outcomes: "mBERT" (light blue), "XLM-R" (dark blue), and "same" (light green). All bars are outlined in black against a lightly textured background. Across the categories, the task counts vary, with the tallest bar in the chart being the dark blue XLM-R bar in the IE-Slavic category, reaching approximately 39. Conversely, the shortest bars are the light blue mBERT bars in the IE-Baltic and Semitic categories, which appear to be at or near 0. Other notable values include the IE-Romance category, where the "same" bar reaches 30, and the IE-Germanic category, where the "same" bar reaches 22 and the XLM-R bar reaches 18.
